final: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_diff, g.avg_abs_diff - o.overall AS diff_vs_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL
